ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) surface with high-intensity (white/yellowish) clusters on distal tips and lower water spray regions; approximate pixel ratio of 90:10 dark to light.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity dark pigmentation across both lobes. Localized high-intensity yellowish-white clusters on the far-left tip and right tip margin. Sparse greyish-white speckling localized to the mid-section of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a central convergence point; approximately 45-55 degree angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge. Noted irregular peak density on the left lobe trailing edge with significant pixel depth variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lobed structure showing an S-shaped sweep: convex transition from the median notch to a sharp concave trajectory toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Two distinct circular 'halo' patterns (rosette scars) visible on the mid-left lobe. Dense clusters of high-contrast calcified organisms (barnacles) on the far-left and far-right tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, parallel diagonal linear disruptions (white/light grey) visible on the lower inner-region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the distal extremities of both lobes. Distinctive circular scars on the left lobe surface consistent with past parasite or barnacle attachment.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular, jagged 'missing' tissue segments on the trailing edge of the left lobe creating a unique serration signature compared to the right lobe.
